```{r}
#| label: "Libraries and setup"
#| include: false
#| echo: false
#| code-fold: false

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(patchwork)
library(colorspace)
library(glue)
library(gt)
library(gtsummary)
library(devtools)
#library(paindrawr)
load_all()

# USE THIS CODE in TERMINAL TO RENDER
# quarto preview /home/steen/projects/paindrawr/presentation/2026_10_29_OUH.qmd --no-browser --no-watch-inputs


theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 14))
theme_gtsummary_compact()

# Load background images
bg_palmar <- here("inst/extdata/lower_arm_palmar.png")
bg_mird <- here("inst/extdata/mird_body_background.png")
bg_zealand <- here("inst/extdata/zealand.png")
```


```{r}
#| label: "load data"
#| include: false
#| echo: false
#| code-fold: false

# Get the Data 
# Get standard data
base_data <- read_csv(here("presentation", "2026_10_29_data.csv")) 

# Keep only relevant columns
base_data <- base_data |>
  select(
    record_id = "Record ID", 
    tool = "Please choose one of the two items", 
    distance = "Please choose a distance" , 
    geography = "How well do you know the geography of east Denmark?" 
    ) |> 
    mutate(
      distance = factor(distance, levels = c("10 centimeters", "1 meter"))
      )


json_files <- list.files(
  here("presentation/2026_10_29_drawings/"),
  pattern = "json$",
  recursive = TRUE
)

paindraw_data <- pdr_import_json(here(
    "presentation/2026_10_29_drawings/",
    json_files
  ))

## Id is nested in the drawing id string
paindraw_data <- paindraw_data |>
  mutate(
    record_id = str_extract(id, "R[0-9]+F") |>
      str_remove("^R") |>
      str_remove("F$") |>
      as.double()
  )

# Because we have multible drawings pr id we go wide before joining
### First extract image type
paindraw_data_wide <- paindraw_data |>
  mutate(
    view = str_extract(id, "F-.+-") |>
      str_remove("^F-") |>
      str_remove("-E.+$") |>
      str_remove("^background_image_")
  ) |>
  select(-id) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = view,
    values_from = pdr_data
  )

my_data <- base_data |>
  left_join(paindraw_data_wide)

## REmove drawing 22
## Keep it for later bug fixing
my_data <- my_data |> filter_out(record_id == 22)

## ADD RGBA
my_data <- my_data |> 
  rename(
    zealand = draw_zealand
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    palmar = pdr_add_rgba(palmar), 
    zealand = pdr_add_rgba(zealand, polygon = "both")
    )

```

## Workflow to get pr. drawing summary stats 

```{mermaid}
%%| echo: false
%%| fig-width: 10
flowchart LR
  A["<div style='text-align:left;white-space:nowrap'><b>JSON file</b><br/>• strokes<br/>• x/y points</div>"]
  B["<div style='text-align:left;white-space:nowrap;width:190px'><b>Tibble</b><br/>• pdr list column</div>"]
  C["<div style='text-align:left;white-space:nowrap;width:190px'><b>Tibble</b><br/>• pdr list column<br/>• .rgba matrix</div>"]
  D["<div style='text-align:left;white-space:nowrap'><b>Tibble with pr drawing summary data</b><br/>• pdr list column<br/>• area: pixels, proportion<br/>• intensity: mean, min, max</div>"]
  V1["<div style='text-align:left;white-space:nowrap;width:190px'><b>Visual analysis</b><br/>• pdr_plot_drawing()<br/>• pdr_plot_heatmap()</div>"]
  V2["<div style='text-align:left;white-space:nowrap;width:190px'><b>Visual analysis</b><br/>• pdr_plot_rgba()<br/>• pdr_plot_rgba_heatmap()</div>"]
  %% Invisible spacers, same size as V1/V2, so B and C sit at column centre
  P1["<div style='width:190px'><b>.</b><br/>.<br/>.</div>"]
  P2["<div style='width:190px'><b>.</b><br/>.<br/>.</div>"]

  %% Column subgraphs: direction TB is only honoured when no node
  %% inside links outside, so the main arrows connect the subgraphs.
  %% Fixed widths keep the arrow ends flush with the Tibble boxes.
  subgraph S1[" "]
    A
  end
  subgraph S2[" "]
    direction TB
    P1 ~~~ B -.-> V1
  end
  subgraph S3[" "]
    direction TB
    P2 ~~~ C -.-> V2
  end
  subgraph S4[" "]
    D
  end

  S1 -->|"pdr_import_json()"| S2
  S2 -->|"pdr_add_rgba()"| S3
  S3 -->|"pdr_summarize_rgba()"| S4

  classDef col fill:none,stroke:none
  class S1,S2,S3,S4 col
  classDef vis stroke-dasharray: 5 5
  class V1,V2 vis
  classDef ghost fill:none,stroke:none,color:transparent
  class P1,P2 ghost
```


## Get summary statistics 

```{r}
#| output-location: fragment
my_data <- my_data |> 
  pdr_summarize_rgba(pdr_list = palmar, summary_stat = c("area", "mean"))

my_data
```


## Summarize across groups

```{r}
#| output-location: fragment
my_data |> 
  group_by(tool, distance) |> 
  summarise(
    area_mean = mean(palmar_area, na.rm = TRUE), 
    area_sd  = sd(palmar_area, na.rm = TRUE),
    intensity_mean = mean(palmar_mean, na.rm = TRUE), 
    intensity_sd = sd(palmar_mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```



## Examples

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| width: 10
my_data |> 
  filter(palmar_area == max(palmar_area, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  pdr_plot_drawing(palmar, background_image = bg_palmar) +
  labs(title = "Largest area") +


my_data |> 
  filter(palmar_area == min(palmar_area, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  pdr_plot_drawing(palmar, background_image = bg_palmar) +
  labs(title = "Smallest area") +
  
my_data |> 
  filter(palmar_mean == max(palmar_mean, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  pdr_plot_drawing(palmar, background_image = bg_palmar) +
  labs(title = "Highest mean intensity")   & 
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)+
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

```
